channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Lambda Pushes Serverless Toward Long-Running Workloads
item.description: AWS Lambda now allows functions running on Lambda Managed Instances to run for up to 90 minutes, six times longer than the previous 15-minute limit, further blurring the line between a Lambda invocation and a traditional server. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon ECS Express Mode now supports AWS Graviton (ARM64) workloads
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service Express Mode now supports specifying ARM64 as the CPU architecture for your service, making it easy to deploy ARM-based container images on AWS Graviton-powered compute and benefit from up to 40% better… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SNS now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB
item.description: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB, a 4x increase from the previous 256 KiB limit, so you can publish larger messages to your SNS topics. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Continuum now supports credential testing and accessible domain suggestions
item.description: AWS Continuum for penetration testing is a frontier agent that proactively secures applications throughout the development lifecycle by offering on-demand, customized penetration testing with real exploitability testing. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Resilience Hub adds three new capabilities
item.description: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub is a central location in the AWS that helps platform engineering and site reliability teams assess and strengthen the resilience of their workloads running on AWS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone affinity
item.description: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone (AZ) affinity for responder gateways. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Kimi K3 by Moonshot AI is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock continues to expand its open weight model portfolio with the same security and governance that customers rely on. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels
item.description: Localhost, meet the Internet. Turn the server on your laptop into a public, encrypted URL on Cloudflare's edge with one command. (1 source: hackernews)
